notes: The stay/change trellis, backtracking, wildcard-label behavior, and character confidence semantics follow the pinned WhisperX source.
VoiceHub replaces NumPy, pandas, NLTK, torchaudio, and Transformers with Torch-only typed processing.

Like WhisperX, text to align is decoded without timestamp tokens per chunk of at most 30 seconds; without a VAD, each Whisper decoding window is one chunk. Aligned segments span their first to last aligned word but are not re-split into sentences with downloaded Punkt data.
